title: 感性評価法
subtitle: Kansei Evaluation
keywords: Psychophysics 2.Magnitude estimation 3.Semantic differential method 4.Sensory evaluation 5.Paired comparison method
educationalGoal: In a function of information processing, the one that emotion strongly affects is called "Kansei". People receive sensory information and evaluate it in some way. Conversely, we can also understand a person's characteristics based on the evaluations he or she has made. In this class, we will deepen our understanding of representative evaluation methods using human senses through practical training. Students will learn measurement and evaluation methods using ordinary things around them.
advice: The main contents of the course are as follows: 1) Overview of psychophysics and psychophysical measurement methods 2) Magnitude estimation method 3) Sensory evaluation 4) SD method and factor analysis 5) Pairwise comparison method Since many group activities will be conducted in the exercises, students should refrain from uncooperative attitudes, unexcused absences, and tardiness that may hinder smooth group activities. The class schedule is subject to change depending on the progress of the class. This course is subject to the course credit system.
requiredKnowledge: Review the contents of previous lectures on psychology, especially Introduction to Psychology and Psychological Experiments, thoroughly.In addition, students will be using web-based survey systems (Qualtrics, Google Form, MS Forms, etc.) in the exercises, so it is recommended that they review how to use these systems.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand psychophysics and its meaning.
Ability to understand and to conduct Magnitude estimation.
Ability to understand and to conduct semantic differentiation method.
Ability to understand and to conduct paired-comparison method.
Ability to use method of Kansei evaluation in the field of manufacturing.
